representation: 55 exact source GP29 page arrays, LP2-00–49 and LP2-51–55; canonical GP Latin labels scored with the pinned source English quadgrams.
procedure: Unchanged source numeric sweep_keystream; source beam records all 50-rune screens and confirms only strict screen survivors on complete pages. Independent scalar reconstruction of every full survivor and maximum screen; independent rescore of all outputs.
parameters: 33 labelled numeric streams at exact length1176 × 55 pages × signs −1/+1 × Atbash off/on × offsets0–4 =36,300 screens. Screen50/beam60/strict>−6.5; survivor full beam200/strict>−5.5; max3 conditional key skips.
exclusions: 841 Fibonacci seed pairs; other numeric catalogs, offsets, clocks, languages and joined pages; no full decoding of rejected screens, full-search null calibration, general key-family exclusion or proof of plaintext.
